facts.en: Completed a stock-control certificate at Fictional Maplecrate Training Centre in 2019.
facts.zh: 2019 年在虚构枫箱培训中心完成库存控制证书课程。

facts.en: Paid office-furniture dispatch assistant at Fictional Pebblepost Furnishings from 2019-04 to 2022-11.
facts.zh: 2019-04 至 2022-11 在虚构卵邮家具公司任有薪办公家具发货助理。

facts.en: In that role, matched labelled furniture items to delivery lists and tracked returned transport crates.
facts.zh: 在该职位将有标签家具与配送清单匹配，并跟踪归还运输箱。

facts.en: Paid nonclinical equipment logistics assistant at Fictional Mallowbrook Hospital from 2023-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-01 至 2026-08 在虚构锦葵溪医院任有薪非临床设备物流助理。

facts.en: Records collection and delivery locations for meeting-room furniture, noticeboards and office storage units.
facts.zh: 记录会议室家具、通知板及办公储物柜的取送位置。

facts.en: Checks item labels against the facilities team’s approved move requests before arranging portering slots.
facts.zh: 安排搬运人员时段前，依据设施团队获批搬移请求核对物品标签。

facts.en: Records visible damage and refers load-handling questions to the portering supervisor.
facts.zh: 记录可见损坏，并将搬运载荷问题转交搬运主管。

facts.en: The assigned portering team performs the moves; the candidate coordinates records and destination confirmations.
facts.zh: 指定搬运团队执行搬移；候选人协调记录及目的位置确认。

facts.en: Helped reconcile a temporary furniture holding area in 2025-04.
facts.zh: 2025-04 协助核对临时家具暂存区。

facts.en: The reconciliation counted 46 tagged items: 31 awaiting delivery and 15 awaiting owner confirmation.
facts.zh: 核对清点 46 件带标签物品：31 件待配送，15 件待物品负责人确认。

facts.en: The 15 unconfirmed items were not classified as lost or written off in the available record.
facts.zh: 现有记录未将这 15 件未确认物品列为丢失，亦未记录核销处理。

facts.en: Personally matched tag numbers to move references; a facilities officer decided final storage allocations.
facts.zh: 个人将标签号与搬移编号匹配；设施专员决定最终存放位置分配。

facts.en: Uses a facilities request portal, barcode lists and spreadsheet location registers.
facts.zh: 使用设施请求门户、条码清单及电子表格位置登记册。

facts.en: Completed hospital site-access and nonclinical logistics induction in 2023-01.
facts.zh: 2023-01 完成医院场地访问及非临床物流入职培训。

facts.en: No handling of patient records, clinical devices or clinical treatment is documented in this role.
facts.zh: 该职位未记录处理患者档案、临床设备或临床治疗的职责。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Reedbasket Community Hall from 2020-03 to 2022-07, arranging chairs for craft meetings.
facts.zh: 2020-03 至 2022-07 在虚构芦篮社区会堂做志愿者，为手工聚会摆放椅子。

facts.en: Made a personal labelled storage box for board-game pieces in 2024 using reused cardboard.
facts.zh: 2024 年利用旧纸板制作个人带标签桌游零件收纳盒。

facts.en: Enjoys drawing room-layout puzzles and making miniature paper furniture.
facts.zh: 爱好绘制房间布局谜题及制作微型纸家具。

facts.en: Confirms completed deliveries with receiving departments before closing move requests.
facts.zh: 在关闭搬移请求前，与接收部门确认已完成配送。

facts.en: Keeps a daily handover of unconfirmed destinations, damaged items and requests awaiting facilities approval.
facts.zh: 维护每日交接，列明未确认目的位置、损坏物品及待设施部门批准的请求。
